What is Sensei Studios?

A calm Mountaintop training space

Why people say Sensei Studios

Our school trains inside Studios on Main. Coach Sandy leads each class. Many neighbors call our dojo Sensei Studios. It joins the coach title with our building. We share this proud home in Tannersville.

Our address is 6045 Main Street. We teach on the second floor. Studio 2 is our home. It is a quiet place to learn jiu-jitsu.

A room built for beginners

We welcome kids, teens, and adults. You can start here at any fitness stage. Classes are calm and small. Sandy pairs each student with care. Partners move at an easy pace.

Every drill teaches leverage and balance. You work with helpful friends. The room stays kind each day.

Clean mats and fresh air

We wash the mats each day. We clean spots that hands touch. We use fresh hospital soap. Shoes stay off the mat space. The floor stays clean for every student.

The room has bright mountain light. Big windows bring in cool Catskills breeze. You train in comfort from start to finish.

Parent viewing and lounge

Parents can watch every youth class. We have benches right beside the mats. You see your child smile, move, and learn.

We also have a quiet lounge by the door. You can sit, read, or work. Free Wi-Fi is ready for you.

Photo Guide to Arrival

How to find and enter Sensei Studios

Follow these simple steps from your car to our mats.

1. Free Easy Parking

Park in the rear paved lot. The lot is wide and free. Street parking on Main Street is free too. You find open spots with ease.

2. Walkway Entrance

Walk along the clean paved path to the main door. A ramp offers smooth rolling access. The path is well lit and clear.

3. Main Lobby Door

Open the front glass door. Step inside the warm lobby. A welcome sign points the way upstairs.

4. Stairs and Elevator

Take the wide wooden stairs to floor two. You can also ride the clean lift. Both choices bring you right to our floor.

5. Second Floor Hallway

Step into the bright hallway. The hall has quiet wood floors and soft light. Follow the hall down toward Studio 2.

6. Studio 2 Doorway

Open the door to Studio 2. Sandy is here to greet you. Take off your shoes. Step onto the clean padded mats.

Studio Comforts

Changing areas, parent seating, and care

Daily Mat Cleanliness

We wash our mats each day with hospital soap. Students keep street shoes off the mat. We keep the room clean, safe, and fresh for children and adults.

Parent Presence Welcome

Parents can sit mat-side and watch every class. You see how your child listens, shares, and builds balance. Our open room keeps families connected.

What to Bring

Your first visit checklist

Keep it simple. You only need a few basic items to train.

Clean Gym Clothes

Wear a comfortable t-shirt. Wear shorts or sweatpants. Keep zippers and buttons at home.

Water Bottle

Bring a bottle of cold water. Take calm sips between drills. Stay fresh throughout class.

Slip-on Shoes

Bring sandals or slip-on shoes. Wear them when you walk off the mats to the restroom.

An Open Mind

Bring a calm smile. Be ready to learn at an easy speed. Sandy guides every single step.
